claim_text: H7 supported on its literal comparison bar: Stage 8 fresh n=96 disjoint confirmation; leading discrete k=8 per-run log-likelihood=-4.71 vs null k=1=-7.82, gap=+3.11 (positive, unlike Level 1.3's own -1.29-vs--6.05 negative collapse). Continuous candidate (pca_factor_continuum) ALSO generalizes well: reconstruction error 0.618 fresh vs 0.597 in-sample (~3.5% increase)
design_type: disjoint fresh-seed confirmation scoring frozen Stage7 fits
uncertainty: point log-likelihood/reconstruction-error values; no CI reported
limitations: a positive gap against a single-Gaussian (k=1) null is a weak discreteness signal on its own, since it is close to mechanically guaranteed for any non-Gaussian continuous density; the continuous candidate's comparable fresh-data performance is the decisive context

Zero shared dimensions confirmed between S_obs (5 components) and Z_obs (3 components) by direct code inspection. PCA factor structure does NOT cleanly recover an S/Z axis split: PC1 (22.8% variance) is loaded by BOTH legitimacy channels together (0.654 performance, 0.674 procedural)
design_type: pooled-observational correlational (multiple defensible weighting variants reported side by side per the source project's own frozen rule against redefining the measure to manufacture a result)

status: VERIFIED-RAW (independently recomputed this milestone directly from stage9_report.json)
